notes.title: 🎉 Our new game Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One is now live for free!

notes.title: Together in Forgotten Lands now has a PlayStation page! 🎮✨
notes.content:
[h2]📢 Hey puzzle lovers![/h2][p][/p][h3]Together in Forgotten Lands now has a PlayStation page! 🎮✨[/h3][p][/p][p]This co-op puzzle adventure, which we have been passionately developing for a year, is now also playable on PlayStation.[/p][p]
You can support us by adding it to your wishlist on PlayStation 👉🏻👈🏻[/p][p][/p][h1][b][url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016010" style="button"]Playstation Page[/url][/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Improvements for our Steam community will continue without pause. Your support means the world to us! 💙[/p]

notes.title: 📌 Name Update
notes.content:
[b]📌 Name Update[/b]

To prevent any potential copyright issues, we’ve renamed the game from “Together in Forgotten Realms” to Together in Forgotten Lands.

Same excitement, new name — the journey continues! 🎮💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508501/87f86d48df078300dcfbb2f3734937f678f75478.png[/img]

📝 Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam and join us on this mysterious co-op adventure! 🧩💖
